# name=flags, one a line; the first is the base the others are held to.
base=
tid=-DPEARL_AMD_TID=1
lpin=-DPEARL_AMD_LPIN=1
pfx=-DPEARL_AMD_PFX=1 -DPEARL_AMD_TID=1
pfxl=-DPEARL_AMD_PFX=1 -DPEARL_AMD_TID=1 -DPEARL_AMD_LPIN=1
pfxlnt=-DPEARL_AMD_PFX=1 -DPEARL_AMD_LPIN=1
crank=-DPEARL_AMD_CRANK=1 -DPEARL_AMD_SCHEDB=1
pfxlc=-DPEARL_AMD_PFX=1 -DPEARL_AMD_TID=1 -DPEARL_AMD_LPIN=1 -DPEARL_AMD_CRANK=1 -DPEARL_AMD_SCHEDB=1
bufld=-DPEARL_AMD_BUFLD=1
bufpfxl=-DPEARL_AMD_BUFLD=1 -DPEARL_AMD_PFX=1 -DPEARL_AMD_TID=1 -DPEARL_AMD_LPIN=1
